chief_complaint: Painful sores involving his private parts for 7 days.
history_of_present_illness: Previously well, developed painful sores on private parts for 7 days.
exposure_and_epidemiology: Had unprotected sex with a commercial sex worker 2 weeks ago.
physical_exam: Numerous painful, tender, soft, bleeding ulcers on penis, scrotum, and inner thigh with no inguinal lymphadenopathy, causing considerable pain and difficulty walking.
labs_and_diagnostics: HIV-negative, syphilis serology positive (RPR and TPHA), culture of Haemophilus ducreyi positive.
management_and_clinical_course: Patient was treated with IM benzathine penicillin 2.4 million units and erythromycin 500 mg qds for 7 days; returned for follow-up after 7 days with resolved pain and healing ulcers.

images.caption: Numerous painful ulcers on the penis, scrotum and inner thigh. The ulcers are soft, tender and bleed on contact.
Follow-up after 1 week of antibiotic therapy. The ulcers are healing and the pain has resolved.
